_comment: Tool definition for the Claude API (strict tool use). lib/prompt.js passes name, description, strict and input_schema inside `tools`, with tool_choice {type:'tool', name:'respond'}. Strict mode guarantees the shape; it cannot enforce counts above 1, so lib/profile.js and api/chat.js enforce 'exactly 3 follow_ups' and all caps. Only `sop` is optional (strict mode allows at most 24 optional parameters in total).
name: respond
description: Send the reply to the person using the NotOnMap portal, plus what you newly learned about them this turn. Always use this tool for every reply.

reply_language.description: Language of this reply: en = English, hi = Hindi in Devanagari, hinglish = Hindi in Roman letters.

answer_markdown.description: The on-screen answer in the reply language. Short paragraphs and bullets. No tables. Do not include the micro-step here.

next_micro_step.description: Exactly one action: under 2 hours, zero money, starts with a verb, one or two sentences, in the reply language.

needs_human_verification.description: True if the answer touches health, food safety, legal, licensing, police registration, insurance, structural, electrical, gas, fire, environmental or tax rules.

follow_ups.description: Exactly 3 tap-button suggestions in the reply language and script, in the person's own voice, each under about 7 words, specific to this person.

profile_update.description: ONLY what is new or changed in the person's latest message. Empty strings and empty lists mean nothing new. Never repeat what the learned context already holds.

clue.description: The person's own words that gave the clue, a few words. Empty if none.

ventures_upsert.description: Things they run or want to start that are new or changed this turn. Reuse the exact label from the learned context when updating.

ventures_remove.description: Labels of ventures the person has dropped.

location.description: Only parts newly mentioned; empty string otherwise.

region.description: Wider area such as Kumaon, Spiti, Western Ghats, Thar.

access.description: How guests reach them and any seasonal problems.

assets_add.description: Things they already have that could serve guests.

log_entries.description: At most 2 short micro-insights that will improve future advice.

source_ids.description: IDs from the relevant-knowledge block that you used. Empty list if none.

sop.description: Only include when the answer contains a repeatable procedure. The portal renders it as a print-ready PDF.

subtitle.description: One short line on who or what it is for.

action.description: One clear action sentence starting with a verb.

filename_slug.description: Lowercase Latin letters and hyphens, e.g. washroom-cleaning.
